description: GRADUATE one of your drops to tier 4 — a real backend (server code, queryable store, isolated SQLite) behind the SAME URL, with its data carried over. This ACTS: it creates the app, moves the data across, and switches the URL over. The owner is emailed. Requires an account token and an ACTIVE app subscription (19 EUR/month per app, founding cohort, Pro included): the owner applies from their space (Grow), places are given in order of arrival, then payment activates it. The URL never changes and the data is carried over. One thing changes on that day: the shared state (the cloud copy of the page's localStorage) becomes PRIVATE to the app's server code and its owner. It is kept, and server.js reads it with app.state, but the served page no longer receives it. If the page must keep finding its data through it, the owner opens it in the cockpit (app page, Data, Shared state), which makes ALL of it readable by every visitor; this cannot be done by MCP. Otherwise move the data to app.records behind your own routes. Pass check=true to get the verdict WITHOUT doing anything. On refusal, returns the COMPLETE list of reasons with what to do about each. Nothing is changed on a refusal — the drop keeps serving.
name: dropyour_graduate
title: Graduate a drop into a real app
